decisions.reason: As the flagship cloud email service, it remains strategically central and cheap to keep, so the option stays open despite reduced visibility.
Document capture is adjacent and not strategically core, and after four years with no visible traction its option value is unlikely to be realized.
Email/fax conversion is an incremental extension with low strategic importance, so after years without prominence the option is abandoned.
Fax delivery optimization is a legacy feature close to the core but misaligned with the cloud direction, making its option value too low to justify keeping.
